title: Cross-class method search for osel
description: Extend osel to search across multiple classes. Example: osel CS* symbol* should find methods across all matching classes. Currently requires running osel on each class manually.

title: oheap: Find live instances on heap
description: Find live instances on heap via malloc introspection. (High complexity)

title: Integration test stability issues
description: Some tests are timing-sensitive and may fail intermittently: test_hierarchy.py NSMutable* timeout on slow machines; shared LLDB session can accumulate state.
close_reason: Original stability problems addressed. The one failing test (--dylib fast path) is a separate performance expectation issue, not stability/flakiness.

title: Fuzzy matching for typo suggestions
description: Suggest corrections for typos in command arguments. (Low complexity)

title: oblock: Block inspector
description: Block inspector showing signature and invoke function. (Medium complexity)

title: Shared cache class scanning
description: Support classes in dyld shared cache not directly loaded. Example: ocls --shared-cache NS*. Many system classes are in shared cache but not enumerated by objc_getClassList.

title: Bitfield position tracking incomplete
description: The --ivars output shows bitfields with bit width but not position within the byte. The runtime's ivar_getOffset() only returns byte offset, not bit position.
close_reason: Won't fix: insufficient info available at runtime

title: Better error messages with suggestions
description: Add 'did you mean' suggestions for common errors. Example: ocall [NSDate distancePast] should suggest +[NSDate distantPast]. Addresses common typos and class/instance method confusion.

title: Add more edge case tests
description: Improve test coverage with edge case tests. (Low complexity)

title: ocat: Category method inspector
description: Category method inspector and collision detector. (Medium complexity)

title: Linux support for unit tests
description: Cross-platform support for running unit tests on Linux. (Low complexity)

title: ograph: Class hierarchy visualization
description: Visualize class hierarchy as a graph. (Medium complexity)

title: CI/CD with GitHub Actions
description: Set up GitHub Actions for unit tests. (Low complexity)

title: omemory: Memory layout inspector
description: Inspect memory layout of objects. (High complexity)
